# Antimicrobial Effect Analysis

## Load Data and Plotting Utilities

```{r load_data_04C, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Load processed plotting data and color schemes
load("data/macro/plot_data.Rdata")
load("data/data_colors.Rdata")
```

## Bacteria-to-Host Read Ratio

This section analyzes the ratio of bacterial reads to host (chicken) reads, which can indicate antimicrobial treatment effects on the microbiome.

### Layers - Bacteria-to-Host Ratio

```{r bacteria_host_ratio_layer_stats, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, comment=""}
# Calculate summary statistics for bacteria-to-host ratio by treatment and age
var <- "bacteria_over_chicken"
summary_stats_layer <- plot_data_stats_macro %>%
  filter(treatment != "TF0") %>%  # Exclude negative controls
  filter(animal_breed == "layer") %>%
  group_by(treatment_expl, age) %>%
  summarise(
    median = median(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    IQR    = IQR(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1     = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3     = quantile(.data[[var]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(label_txt = formatC(median, format = "f", digits = 2))

# Display summary statistics table with proper formatting
knitr::kable(summary_stats_layer, digits = 3, caption = "Summary statistics (median and IQR) for bacteria:host ratio in layers by treatment and age")
```

```{r bacteria_host_ratio_layer_plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
# Create boxplot showing bacteria-to-host ratio over time for layers
boxplot_reads_prc_1 <- plot_data_stats_macro %>%
  filter(treatment != "TF0") %>%
  filter(animal_breed == "layer") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = bacteria_over_chicken, color = treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, color = "black") +  # Boxplot without outliers
  geom_jitter(width = 0.05, alpha = 0.5) +  # Individual data points
  scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colours_bright) +
  facet_nested(. ~ treatment_expl, scales = "fixed", space = "fixed", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Days post infection", y = "Bacteria/host reads ratio") +
  guides(color = "none") +  # Remove legend
  theme_minimal() +
  custom_ggplot_theme +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  # Add median values as text labels above boxes
  geom_text(
    data = summary_stats_layer,
    aes(x = age, y = median, label = label_txt),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -3.0,
    size = 3, alpha = 1, color = "black"
  ) +
  ggtitle("Layers")

# Display the plot (commented out - used in combined plot)
# boxplot_reads_prc_1
```

### Combined Visualization

```{r bacteria_host_ratio_combined, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.height=7, fig.width=8}
# Combine both plots for side-by-side comparison
boxplot_reads_prc_1 / boxplot_reads_prc_2 + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'a')
```
